partnership_emails.subject: Free Tech Workshops for Seniors — Onyx Systems Community Partnership
partnership_emails.body:
Hi {director_name},

I'm John Gunther, owner of Onyx Systems | Total Computer Care in Lake City (757 SW State Rd 247 Ste 108). Since 1997, we've helped local residents with computer repair, virus removal, data recovery, and tech tutoring.

I'm reaching out to propose a **free technology workshop series** for your senior community members. Many seniors face challenges with scams, software updates, video calling, and basic computer maintenance — and we'd like to help bridge that gap.

**Workshop topics (each 45-60 min, scheduled monthly or quarterly):**
• **"Spot the Scam"** — How to identify phishing, fake tech support calls, and gift card scams.
• **"Stay Connected"** — Setting up and using video calling (FaceTime, Zoom, Google Meet) to keep in touch with family.
• **"Computer Health Check"** — Simple steps to keep a computer running smoothly (updates, cleanup, backups).
• **"Ask the Tech"** — Open Q&A where attendees bring their specific questions.

**What Onyx Systems provides:**
• Experienced instructor (John, 29 years local tech experience).
• All presentation materials and handouts.
• Free diagnostics for any attendee's device after the workshop.
• Senior discount (15% off any repair service).

**What we need from you:**
• A room with a projector/screen or TV (we bring laptop and clicker).
• Promotion in your newsletter/bulletin 2 weeks before each session.
• 10-15 attendee minimum for a viable session.

**Community benefit:** Empowers seniors to use technology safely and confidently; builds trust between Onyx Systems and the senior community for future repair needs.

Would you be open to a brief call to discuss scheduling? I'm happy to tailor topics to your members' interests.

Best regards,
John Gunther
Onyx Systems | Total Computer Care

https://onyxpc.us

partnership_emails.subject: Referral Partnership: Onyx Systems + {partner_name} — Complementary Services
partnership_emails.body:
Hi {owner_name},

I'm John Gunther, owner of Onyx Systems | Total Computer Care in Lake City. We focus on **consumer and small-business computer repair**: hardware diagnostics, virus/malware removal, data recovery, OS installs/upgrades (Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS), and on-site IT support for homes and small offices.

I see {partner_name} handles more enterprise-focused IT services — managed services, server infrastructure, network design, and security compliance. Our services don't compete; they complement. I'd like to propose a **formal referral partnership**.

**How it works:**
• **You refer** clients who need break/fix hardware repair, data recovery, or consumer device support → Onyx Systems handles it; you get a **10% referral fee** (or reciprocal credit).
• **We refer** clients who outgrow break/fix and need managed IT, server setup, or compliance → {partner_name} handles it; we get a **10% referral fee** (or reciprocal credit).
• Both parties maintain their own client relationships; we act as trusted specialists for the respective tier.

**Why this makes sense for Lake City/North Florida:**
• The 30-mile service area (Columbia, Suwannee, Gilchrist, Baker, Union counties) has limited specialized tech providers.
• A referral network ensures every prospect lands with the right skill set, faster.
• Joint marketing: co-branded one-pager for local chambers, cross-promotion in newsletters, shared booth at local business expos.

**Next steps:**
1. Quick 15-min call to align on referral process and fee structure.
2. Exchange ideal client profiles and service boundary definitions.
3. Draft a simple MOU (non-exclusive, 90-day trial).

If this aligns with your growth strategy, let's set up a call. I'm flexible — mornings or late afternoons work best.

Best regards,
John Gunther
Onyx Systems | Total Computer Care
(386) 755-7772
https://onyxpc.us
